_comment: Test set format. Each key is a query string; each value lists the segment IDs judged relevant to it. The queries below are invented for illustration. The intent rules in detect_intent() match on Chinese keywords — 決定 / 放棄 / 還要 / 考慮過 / 為什麼 — so a test set written in another language will fire no rules and every configuration will fall back to plain similarity ranking. The test set used in the study is withheld: the corpus is personal and the questions are drawn from it.
